page.headline: One Mac-to-mars transfer run is underway; its question is unrecorded
page.intro: The lab compares file-transfer performance across its machines. Today the schedule lists one runner, mac-mac, which covers the Mac and mars pair. Its only queued experiment is already running, with 200 samples, and the schedule has no question, hypothesis, or decision tree recorded for it. No follow-on branches are listed.

items.why: It is the only experiment on the mac-mac runner and is running now with 200 samples, but its question and hypothesis are not recorded in today's schedule.
